cases.reason: Under Core 0.20, if a semantic object can be definitionally decomposed into lower logical structure, it is not an admissible authoritative leaf. The available definition for LINKED must be expanded.
Qualified constructions may be referenced for caching or navigation but cannot replace primitive support for a primitive-closure claim when their internal semantics are load-bearing.
Arithmetic operations and comparisons are semantic constructions that must be unfolded to a primitive basis; they are not authoritative leaves.
Computation predicates like ACCEPTS must expose configuration, transition, and trace semantics to satisfy primitive-logic closure.
Raw carrier identities are permitted as primitive leaves when their internal content is irrelevant and all behavior is expressed through separate primitive logical relations.
Domain labels are derived views. Exact source reconstruction must succeed from the primitive kernel even if the derived view is removed.
Discovery Protocol may use abstractions for search, but exact admission requires the result to be projected back to primitive support.
If a lower definition is unavailable for a load-bearing relation, it must be marked as QU_UNEXPANDED rather than being promoted to a primitive leaf.
Sidecars cannot supply load-bearing semantic meaning that is absent from the native structure or its qualified primitive expansion.
Core 0.20 does not retroactively invalidate Core 0.19 renderings, but a rendering that stops at a qualified construction is incomplete under the 0.20 primitive-closure rule.
The rendering contains only raw identities and primitive logical relations (incidence and closed-world constraints), satisfying primitive closure and exact round-trip requirements.
Primitive semantics reside in the kernel; derived domain labels are non-authoritative views. Relabeling them does not change the underlying primitive logic.
A qualified construction is permitted as a derived view if the complete primitive expansion is also present and provides the authoritative support.
While literals are raw data, arithmetic operators like ADD are semantic constructions that must be expanded to primitive logic.
Primitive observation incidences are allowed leaves when their full semantic contribution is exactly the represented incidence and no internal behavior is load-bearing.
Domain-flavored names for raw carrier identities do not violate closure if the names carry no behavior and all logic is represented separately.
The rendering passes the primitive-support firewall because the exact claim remains reconstructable from primitive relations after the derived view is removed.
The rendering fails because the exact assertion is connected only through a lossy derived view; removing the view disconnects the assertion from primitive support.
